beats.summary: Jim plans a lake trip with Pam and the kids, including a stop at a pie stand.

evidence.snippet: Jim: I'm gonna drive you up to the lake, give you a whole week on the water. Just you, me and the kids.
Pam: Oh, can we stop by that pie stand on the way?

beats.summary: Dwight introduces a mobile work bus as a temporary workspace for the office.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: In my contract, it is stipulated that I provide a temporary work space. It will arrive in one hour.
Dwight (Bus pulls into lot): Bring it in!

beats.summary: The work bus environment causes discomfort and accidents among employees, including Pam getting spilled on.
Jim tries to convince Dwight and Andy to make the work bus experience better by stopping at a pie stand.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Alright! The fat people have spoken! Dwight, get this bus moving.

beats.summary: Employees engage in playful activities and role call on the work bus.

evidence.snippet: Group: Shabooyah, role call. Shabooyah, yah yah shabooyah, role call.

beats.summary: Erin helps Nellie with a pre-adoption form and they discuss adoption terminology and feelings.

evidence.snippet: Erin: Absolutely. I know exactly what they want to hear. I would love to help.
Erin: Always say that a child is placed for adoption, never surrendered. We're not hostages.
